LanguageData.ER_Intro: Easy Reading — Book skills and repeat orders
LanguageData.ER_ShowBookcaseIcons: Show skill icons in bookcase Contents (default ON)
LanguageData.ER_ShowReadMenuIcons: Show skill icons in right-click Read menu (default ON)
LanguageData.ER_ReadMenuIconsDesc: Adds 1-2 skill icons at the right edge of Book.Read options only. Ordinary Read/Ctrl/Alt actions are unchanged.
LanguageData.ER_ShowTradeIcons: Show skill icons in trading window (default ON)
LanguageData.ER_TradeIconsDesc: Textbooks only; reserves space in the trade item name column. Price, quantity, and trade controls are untouched. Mixed-skill stacks get no icons.
LanguageData.ER_IconSizeLabel: Textbook icon size (Contents / Read menu / Trade):
LanguageData.ER_TradePositionLeft: Left of book title (after info button, default)
LanguageData.ER_BookIconsFooter: Textbooks use actual skill rewards; other books retain vanilla labels and actions.
LanguageData.ER_WorkToggle: Allow manually ordered reading during Work (default ON)
LanguageData.ER_WorkDesc: Only player-ordered Reading jobs (normal / Shift / Ctrl / Alt) ignore the Work schedule's joy-time restriction. Automatic reading and other jobs stay vanilla. Other reading termination rules are unchanged.
LanguageData.ER_DebugDesc: Diagnostic messages are intended for troubleshooting; leave this OFF during normal play.
LanguageData.ER_RepeatEnabled: Enable repeat reading on book Read menu
LanguageData.ER_KeysDesc1: Default: Ctrl+Read queues preset; Alt+Read opens dialog. Normal Read and Shift+Read stay vanilla.
LanguageData.ER_KeysDesc2: Keys work only on book Read options. Other mods may still use the same key; change the binding if necessary.
LanguageData.ER_RestoreConfirm: Restore all Easy Reading settings to defaults? Saved shortcuts and numbers will reset.
LanguageData.ER_DisableConfirm: Disable Easy Reading options? Saved numbers and shortcuts are retained. Existing queued reading jobs are not cancelled.
LanguageData.ER_RestoreDone: Easy Reading defaults restored and saved.
LanguageData.ER_DisableDone: Easy Reading features disabled and saved.
LanguageData.ER_QueueDesc: Queues 1-50 reading jobs after existing orders.
LanguageData.ER_PressKey: Press Ctrl, Alt, A-Z, or F6-F12.
LanguageData.ER_KeyInstructions: Keys are active only while clicking a book's Read menu option. Esc cancels. Shift is reserved for vanilla queueing.
LanguageData.ER_KeyErrorAllowed: Use Ctrl, Alt, A-Z or F6-F12. Shift, Esc and Enter are reserved.
LanguageData.ER_KeyErrorDuplicate: That key is already assigned to the other reading command.
